William D. Zabel, High-Flying Lawyer and Civil Rights Champion, Dies at 89

His work in advancing civil rights, particularly in legalizing interracial marriage, left a lasting legacy. According to the New York State Bar Association, Zabel’s career spanned five decades, with his firm handling over 150 complex financial recoveries by 2009.
